title: Fix deployment errors and redeploy

requirements.text: Audit and fix all backend Motoko compilation errors in backend/main.mo that are causing deployment failures. Ensure the actor compiles cleanly with no type errors, missing imports, or undefined references.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo compiles without errors or warnings
All referenced types and functions are defined or imported correctly

requirements.text: Audit and fix all frontend TypeScript compilation errors in the React/TypeScript frontend. Ensure all type imports, component props, and hook return types are correctly aligned between frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and consuming components so the Vite build completes successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: The Vite/TypeScript build completes with zero type errors
All frontend components import and use backend-derived types correctly
No missing or mismatched type declarations remain

constraints: Do not alter any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve the single-actor Motoko architecture — all logic must remain in backend/main.mo
Do not change existing data models or remove any existing functionality
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond what is already implemented
Refactoring code that is not related to the compilation/deployment errors
Changing the visual design or UI layout
